title: Nashville employees reportedly edited WatchGuard body-camera footage without permission
summary: WPLN reported that a Metro Nashville Police Department internal investigation found two civilian IT employees had removed profanity from body-camera recordings without permission, including footage supplied to the Community Oversight Board for a police-misconduct investigation. WPLN later reported that MNPD was reviewing more than 300 recordings, but the underlying internal-investigation file is not linked in a stable public copy and the available reports are from one newsroom.

sources.title: Internal investigation shows editing of MNPD body camera footage was more widespread than claimed
key_claims: WPLN reported that an obtained internal investigation found two IT employees edited body-camera footage without permission.
WPLN reported that edited footage had been supplied to the Community Oversight Board during a police-misconduct investigation.

sources.title: More than 300 body camera videos are under review by MNPD for improper editing
key_claims: WPLN reported that MNPD was reviewing more than 300 recordings for improper editing.

verification_status.reason: The reports quote and describe an MNPD internal investigation, but the underlying record is not linked in a stable public copy and all available detailed reporting located so far comes from one newsroom.
evidence_needed: A stable copy of the MNPD internal-investigation record or audit findings
Independent reliable corroboration of the unauthorized editing and its scope

title: Tesla employees reportedly shared sensitive vehicle-camera recordings
summary: Reuters reported, based on interviews with nine former employees, that Tesla workers circulated sensitive images and videos captured by customer-vehicle cameras through internal messaging channels between 2019 and 2022. A later proposed class action repeated the allegations, and two U.S. senators requested answers from Tesla. No public regulator finding, adjudicated merits finding, or company admission has been located, so the case remains reported but unverified.

sources.title: Tesla hit with class action lawsuit over alleged privacy intrusion
key_claims: Reuters reported that nine former employees described internal sharing of sensitive customer-camera recordings between 2019 and 2022.

sources.title: Yeh v. Tesla class-action complaint
sources.publisher: U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California
key_claims: The complaint alleged that Tesla employees accessed and shared invasive customer-camera recordings for personal entertainment.

sources.title: Letter to Tesla on Vehicle Camera Recordings
sources.publisher: U.S. Senators Edward Markey and Richard Blumenthal
key_claims: The senators requested information from Tesla about employee access, internal sharing, safeguards, and customer notice.

verification_status.reason: Detailed allegations come from former-employee reporting and a civil complaint, neither of which is an adjudicated finding. No regulator finding or Tesla admission has been located.
evidence_needed: A public regulator or law-enforcement finding substantiating employee sharing
A Tesla admission, audit record, or adjudicated court finding on the alleged conduct

title: Texas sheriff's office reportedly used national Flock search in abortion-related investigation
summary: 404 Media reported that the Johnson County Sheriff's Office searched a nationwide Flock camera network for a woman who had self-administered an abortion. The same newsroom later reported that court records characterized the matter as a death investigation and showed investigators considered possible criminal charges.

sources.title: A Texas Cop Searched License Plate Cameras Nationwide for a Woman Who Got an Abortion
key_claims: 404 Media reported that the sheriff's office searched a nationwide Flock camera network for the woman.

sources.title: Police Said They Surveilled Woman Who Had an Abortion for Her 'Safety.' Court Records Show They Considered Charging Her With a Crime
key_claims: The follow-up said court records described a death investigation and possible criminal charges.

verification_status.reason: Both available reports come from the same newsroom, and the underlying court record is not linked in a stable public copy.
evidence_needed: The underlying court record or another primary official record
Independent reliable corroboration of the Flock search and its purpose
